description: This Java class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for MobileAppBundle entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, querying by tenant ID, package name, platform, and managing OAuth2 clients related to mobile app bundles.

classes.name: JpaMobileAppBundleDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing MobileAppBundle entities, implementing MobileAppBundleDao interface with methods for querying, adding, removing OAuth2 clients, and deleting by tenant.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JPA repository for MobileAppBundleEntity.

methods.name: findInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated MobileAppBundleInfo objects filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Finds MobileAppBundleInfo by tenant ID and bundle ID.

methods.name: findOauth2ClientsByMobileAppBundleId
methods.description: Lists OAuth2 clients associated with a specific mobile app bundle.

methods.name: addOauth2Client
methods.description: Adds a new OAuth2 client to a mobile app bundle.

methods.name: removeOauth2Client
methods.description: Removes an OAuth2 client from a mobile app bundle.

methods.name: findByPkgNameAndPlatform
methods.description: Finds a mobile app bundle by package name and platform type.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all mobile app bundles associated with a tenant ID.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is MOBILE_APP_BUNDLE.
